placements.title: Knowledge directed for erasure
placements.frame: What knowledge is the organization directed to erase, and what institutional claims justify its removal?
placements.why: All three segments perform a single thematic act: src-1 and src-2 are imperative directives commanding the erasure of specific calibration knowledge (the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, Quill Ashgrove's work), while src-3 supplies the corrective institutional assertion ('The observatory never calibrated it') that justifies the erasure. The theme — directed knowledge erasure under institutional authority — names a subject future envelopes could feed if the organization issues further erasure directives or corrective claims about its records. The graph and strata are both empty, so nothing existing holds this as a child.
